author: pk910
content:
yea,  we hit a issue in dora with the current proofs loading architecture.
right now, all proofs are fetched per page call from up to 5 nodes,  which gets a bottleneck when a search engine crawls the slot pages in batches 😄
I'm changing it to properly index proofs now,   but it looks like there's no sse topic  and only a lighthouse branch supports the current `/eth/v1/beacon/execution_proofs/...` call :/
So yea,  the question as barnabas asked:  how should proofs be consumed?

author: taulepton_
content:
<@412614104222531604> <@808969530608451584> In our fork of lighthouse we provide the following beacon api endpoint to fetch execution proofs from the beacon client `GET beacon/execution_proofs/{block_id}`:

https://github.com/eth-act/lighthouse/blob/274af519780614b622ff8af7f180dbc1cf0f22c1/beacon_node/http_api/src/beacon/execution_proofs.rs#L49

The idea would be that you query this endpoint to fetch the proofs for the blocks that you need. Let me know what you think about this pattern?
